description_en: Queries the information about a specific version of a driver
description_zh: 查询驱动某一版本的信息
name: GetEdgeDriverVersion

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The driver ID. On the Driver Management page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the driver ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates a successful call. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

Argument.description_en: The JVM (Java Virtual Machine) startup parameters

ConfigCheckRule.description_en:
The configuration validation rule. A JSON format character string in the following format:

`{"deviceConfig":{"required":false},"driverConfig":{"required":false}`

Parameter descriptions:

driverConfig: the configuration validation rule for the driver in the edge instance.
deviceConfig: the configuration validation rule for devices under the driver in the edge instance
ConfigCheckRule.description_zh:
配置校验规则。JSON格式字符串，格式如下：

`{"deviceConfig":{"required":false},"driverConfig":{"required":false}`

参数说明如下。

driverConfig：表示边缘实例中该驱动的配置校验规则。
deviceConfig：表示边缘实例中该驱动下设备的配置校验规则

ContainerConfig.description_en: The container configuration. A JSON format character string. For parameter descriptions, refer to the ContainerConfig table in this topic
ContainerConfig.description_zh: 容器配置。JSON格式字符串，参数说明，请参见本文下方ContainerConfig表格

DriverConfig.description_en:
The driver configuration. A JSON format character string in the following format:

`{"format":"JSON","content":"{}"}`

Parameter descriptions:

format: the configuration format. Valid values: KV (key-value pair), JSON (JSON format), and FILE (configuration file).
content: the configuration content. When format is KV or JSON, this is the configuration content. When format is FILE, this is the OSS address
DriverConfig.description_zh:
驱动配置。JSON格式字符串，格式如下：

`{"format":"JSON","content":"{}"}`

参数说明如下所示。

format：配置格式。取值有KV（键值对配置）、JSON（JSON格式）、FILE（配置文件）。
content：配置内容。format为KV或JSON时，此处为配置内容；format为FILE时，此处为OSS地址。

EdgeVersion.description_en: The edge version that the driver is compatible with

GmtCreateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the driver was created

GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the driver was last updated
GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_zh: 最后一次更新驱动的Unix时间戳

SourceConfig.description_en:
The driver code source configuration. A JSON string in the following format:

`{"ossAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip","temporaryOssAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip?Expires***"}`

In this format, `ossAddress` is the Object Storage Service (OSS) access address, and `temporaryOssAddress` is a temporary download link that is valid for 5 minutes
SourceConfig.description_zh:
驱动代码来源配置。JSON格式字符串，格式如下：

`{"ossAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip","temporaryOssAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip?Expires***"}`

其中，`ossAddress`为对象存储（OSS）访问地址，`temporaryOssAddress`为可以直接下载的临时链接，有效期5分钟

VersionState.description_en:
The driver version status.

0: The version is not published.
1: The version is published
VersionState.description_zh:
驱动版本状态。

0：表示该版本未发布。
1：表示该版本已发布

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
